items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: md Generated, json ran_at and the dashboard date come from one run instant; stale md is flagged; tests pin it.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable json or unparseable Generated degrade to the tracked record / stale-date-unknown, never raise.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: ran_at is validated as an ISO timestamp before it reaches markdown.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert rendered dates on a fixture, the banner text, fallback without json, stale json, fractional seconds.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One small json read per render.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: read_report_ran_at lives with the record loader; audit_detector.py kept at its baseline size.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: audit-report.json gains ran_at; producer write() and consumers (dashboard, banner) round-tripped in tests.
